class.name: TileMapPathGraph
class.brief_description: A pathfinding graph built from a [TileMapLayer].

method.name: _get_cell_cost
method.description: Override to compute the cost of entering [param cell] yourself. When overridden, [member TileMapPathGraphOptions.cost_data_layer] and [member TileMapPathGraphOptions.default_cost] are not used. [param tile_data] is [code]null[/code] for empty cells. Negative values are treated as [code]0[/code]. Called for every cell of the graph at [method update_all] and for each given cell at [method update_cells], so keep it fast on large maps.

method.name: _is_cell_blocked
method.description: Override to decide yourself whether [param cell] is blocked. When overridden, [member TileMapPathGraphOptions.blocked_data_layer] and [member TileMapPathGraphOptions.empty_cells_blocked] are not used. [param tile_data] is [code]null[/code] for empty cells.

method.name: cell_to_point_id
method.description: Returns the [AStar2D] point id of [param cell] used by the graph backend: [code]((x + 32768) << 16) | (y + 32768)[/code]. The id is never negative and unique for every cell a [TileMapLayer] can save (-32768 to 32767 per coordinate). Returns [code]-1[/code] and prints an error for cells outside that range. See [method point_id_to_cell].

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a graph for [param layer] with [param options] (default options if [code]null[/code]) and builds it with [method update_all]. For a subclass with overridden virtuals, use [code]new()[/code], [method set_layer] and [method update_all] instead.

method.name: get_astar
method.description: Returns the [AStar2D] of the graph backend, or [code]null[/code] when the grid backend is used. Point ids come from [method cell_to_point_id], positions are local positions of the layer. Changes made directly are lost at the next [method update_all].

method.name: get_astar_grid
method.description: Returns the [AStarGrid2D] of the grid backend, or [code]null[/code] when the graph backend is used. Points are the cells themselves; positions are in cell units, not local positions. Useful for advanced settings such as [member AStarGrid2D.jumping_enabled] on large square maps. Changes made directly are lost at the next [method update_all].

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns the backend chosen at the last [method update_all].

method.name: get_cell_cost
method.description: Returns the cost of entering [param cell], or [code]0[/code] for cells outside [method get_region].

method.name: get_cell_path
method.description: Returns the cells of the cheapest path from [param from] to [param to], both included. Returns an empty array if there is no path, if [param from] is blocked or if a cell is outside [method get_region]. If [param allow_partial_path] is [code]true[/code] and [param to] can't be reached, returns the path to the reachable cell closest to [param to].

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the layer the graph is built from, or [code]null[/code] if none is set or it was freed.

method.name: get_point_path
method.description: Like [method get_cell_path], but returns the centers of the cells as local positions of the layer ([method TileMapLayer.map_to_local]).

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the cells covered by the graph: the used rect of the layer at the last build ([method TileMapLayer.get_used_rect]). Grows when [method update_cells] gets a painted cell outside of it.

method.name: is_cell_blocked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] is blocked or outside [method get_region].

method.name: point_id_to_cell
method.description: Returns the cell of an [AStar2D] point id made by [method cell_to_point_id].

method.name: set_layer
method.description: Sets the layer the graph is built from. The graph keeps no reference to it. Call [method update_all] afterwards.

method.name: update_all
method.description: Builds the whole graph from the layer: chooses the backend, takes the used rect, resolves the custom data layer names and computes every cell. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] without a layer or [TileSet], and [constant ERR_PARAMETER_RANGE_ERROR] if the graph backend gets cells outside -32768 to 32767. Emits [signal updated].

method.name: update_cells
method.description: Recomputes only [param cells] (blocked state and cost) after they were changed in the layer. Cells outside [method get_region] that now hold a tile trigger a full [method update_all]. Emits [signal updated].

members.member: The settings of the graph. Setting [code]null[/code] restores the defaults. Changes take effect at the next [method update_all].

signal.name: updated
signal.description: Emitted after [method update_all] and [method update_cells], for example to redraw a debug overlay.

constants.constant: [AStarGrid2D]: square maps and isometric maps with a diamond layout. Compact and contiguous in memory.
[AStar2D] with the neighbors of the [TileSet] layout: stacked and stairs isometric, half-offset square and hexagon maps.
Represents the size of the [enum Backend] enum.
